analysis_role: Post hoc exploratory descriptive diagnostic; no significance testing
primary_target: Gamma=2 weighted rank correlation of current post-FSR knowledge ranks and utility on the entire unmeasured pool
control_target: Ordinary Spearman on the same unmeasured pool
estimators: Archived observed-set pre-update EWRC and ordinary Spearman from the same CALM state
weight_transform: clip(0.6*rho, 0, 0.6); pool-based transformed values are diagnostic references, not optimal weights
cohort: All 218 previously defined pre-optimum query states with a preceding query weight; 55 runs, all nine tasks
aggregation: Average errors across states within run, then equally across available runs within task, then equally across nine tasks
limitations: Predictors use premeasurement raw scores on observed candidates; targets use current post-FSR percentile ranks on different, unmeasured candidates.
This measures cross-set and cross-update-state agreement, not strict calibration/generalization of an unchanged scoring model.
The primary target itself emphasizes high utility with gamma=2, favoring conceptual alignment with EWRC; the ordinary-Spearman target is retained to expose this dependence.
Complete unmeasured-pool labels are used for offline diagnosis only; no feedback or acquisition is changed.
Pool-based weight transform is not an oracle utility-optimal fusion weight; lower error does not prove higher search reward.
formula: Average-tie ranks a,b; w=(b/n)^gamma; weighted Pearson correlation of a and b
